skills.title: Why Our Bodies Need Food
skills.description: Food gives you energy and helps your teeth, skin, bones, muscles, and brain grow strong. Pick the reasons food helps your body and mind.

skills.title: Knowing How to Stay Safe
skills.description: Know your phone number, when and how to call 9-1-1, and which trusted adults can help you. Learn the safe way to be picked up from school.

skills.title: Caring for Body and Mind
skills.description: Your mind is part of your health, just like your body. Find things you can do to take care of both.

skills.title: Using Canada's Food Guide
skills.description: Canada's Food Guide shows which foods and drinks help you eat well. Sort foods into the groups the guide shows.

skills.title: Hunger, Thirst, and Full Cues
skills.description: Your body tells you when you are hungry, thirsty, or full. Match the body clues to what you should do.

skills.title: Caring and Harmful Behaviours
skills.description: Tell caring actions, like listening and asking first, from hurtful ones, like bullying or unwanted touching. Know how each feels and what to do, including telling a trusted adult.

skills.title: Staying Safe at School
skills.description: Pick safe choices at school, like telling your teacher about allergies, playing in safe areas, and using safe routes to and from school.

skills.title: Spotting Dangers and Injuries
skills.description: Spot things that can hurt you at home, outside, near water, on the road, and online. Choose how to stay safe from each one.

skills.title: Habits That Hurt or Help
skills.description: Some habits, like too much screen time, smoking, or vaping, can hurt your health. Find healthier choices and ways to cheer people toward them.

skills.title: Thoughts, Feelings, and Actions
skills.description: What you think, feel, and do can change how your mind feels. Match helpful and unhelpful thoughts and actions to how they affect you.
